reviews.x: These are really good hair clips!  They clamp well, are easy to handle, and they unclamp without snagging hair.  Good on gray/silver hair.

reviews.t: Holds gray hair no one knows there is a clip doing the jov=b
reviews.x: I like these hair clips because they disappear in gray hair. I can place them in my hair and hide the clip.

They do exactly what they're supposed to do and there's a bunch of them in the bag, so they'll last if you lose a few. I have grey hair, so I got the silver color to blend in better. As others have mentioned, the round punch hole will catch on your hair when you take them out. It was fairly obvious that the problem could be solved by flattening the punch hole. I took a pair of regular pliers (not needle-nosed) and flattened each of the clips. It didn't even take 5 minutes of effort and they work

I am so glad I found these online. For some reason nowhere local has silver snap slips. These seem to be good quality and definitely worth the price for the amount given. I could see myself ordering these again for sure!

reviews.t: Coat the tips so they don't rip your hair out
reviews.x: I love the color. Did not enjoy removing them, as they snag and grip hairs upon removal. Ouch. I hated these until I coated the tips, on each side, with a coat of clear top coat of nail polish. Now they don't rip my hair out! Yay!
This was just what I wanted...strong clips that kept my hair in place. Great product and a great buy! I would buy this again and recommend it to friends!

If you notice in the picture of the product there is a small circular rivet holding the two pieces together.  This rivet is not completely welded in place so it catches your hair and when you try and remove these from your hair, your hair will catch on this rivet and break or be pulled out.... I have thick curly hair and use these types of clips all the time.  I just threw out the entire bag of these as they are pulling and breaking my hair.  TERRIBLE PRODUCT!!
Hair always gets caught in that little circle and can’t be removed without ripping hair out. Bad design.
Read most of the reviews about the clips getting their hair pulled and that didn’t happen to me. Love the material very sturdy.
Arrived early, great for making snap clips with faux leather.

I've been looking for clips like this for my newly shorter hair and wanted the silver color to match my Covid grey shade. Functionally they are fine until you try to remove them. I wish I'd taken a photo of the wads of hair my husband had to cut off because it was heartbreaking to lose so much - easily 10-12 strands per clip were permanently caught in between the metal pieces and I was wearing six clips in my hair on Thanksgiving. Such a bummer. Don't waste your money on these. Save your hair!

I'm a knitter, and I use these little clips to secure the end of the yarn to the whole ball, so you don't end up with tangled yarn.  They are amazing for that and well worth the price.  I ended up ordering another bag since I have so much yarn!

Nice gold color but some do tarnish. They do it’s job and clips down my fly aways. Most of the clips pull out my hair and there’s no way of taking it out without taking the hair with it so I don’t know if it’s worth.

I would not buy these again. I can't even use them. Once you snap them into your hair they are almost impossible to get out with out ripping several strands of hair out. It happens every time!! Very disappointing!

An amazing investment for any woman! Walmart charges an arm and a leg for a 8 pack of these! My biggest concern was if they’d be the same quality as the ones in stores. The answer is YES! And even better!

reviews.t: Great for holding quilt binding in place.
reviews.x: Great for holding the binding of our new Quilt of Valor, held all the layers of fabric in place as we hand stitched. Good and strong.
Heap and snag your hair. They tarnish if you get them wet at all and snag my hair everytime I take them out. Would not recommend.
Horrible! Don’t buy unless you want the rivet to get caught in you hair!

I want to like these so bad. They work well when putting them in and holding hair in place. Unfortunately, every single time I try to remove them, it rips my hair due to it getting snagged on the clip. I even tried to put a little bit of clear nail polish on the end to seal the gap where the hair was catching but it peeled off within a few uses and went right back to ripping my hair out.

They are cheap because they will rip your hair out. Unfortunately I couldn’t find any locally or for better quality. Makes me really sad that I have to resort to getting things from Amazon that are subpar quality because nothing else was available after searching for months. If I had a picture of the chunks of hair attached to the clips I would post it.

Although you get a lot of clips for the money, the way they are constructed is BAD! Every one of these specific clips I’ve used somehow some part of it gets caught in my hair and I am unable to get it out without ripping out hair..... other clips of this style that I have do not do that.... don’t buy these!!!!

reviews.t: Your hair WILL get stuck in the rivet and/or the metal overlap. Ripped out my hair!
reviews.x: DO NOT BUY! My hair was stuck in all three clips I was using! In the rivets and the overlapping metal that the rivet is connecting. They ripped my hair out and I’m livid. The star rating this product has is absolute bs! I’m throwing them all away. I’ve never had this happen with similar clips in my life

They are ALMOST perfect.. sturdy yes but they are not like the photos. More than half of the clips were warped/damaged somehow (see pics) Like the gold coating wasn't done properly? More than half of the clips were damaged in that way. Out of the 50 clips only 20 of them were close to being perfect.

Disappointed! The joined end is poorly compressed leaving a gap that catches your hair so tightly that it pulls your hair out when you try to remove them. I tried removing them slowly and that was no help. I'm going to try putting clear nail polish over the ends in hopes of sealing the gap.

I’m growing out my hair I use these to keep it out of my face. I’m blonde to the color is great. They are difficult to use they open and close hard.  I do have bad hands but I have some bought at the drugstore clips which open and close with ease.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the clips snag and pull or break hair on removal, often due to the small circular rivet/hole catching strands.
Reviewers praise the clips as well made, sturdy, and good value, with plenty in the bag for the price.
The silver color is popular for blending into gray/silver hair.
Some reviewers find the clips work well and hold hair in place as intended.
A few reviewers use the clips for non-hair purposes like knitting or crafting.
